# SpikeDrivenMOT

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A multi-object tracking framework that uses spiking neural networks to process event-based visual data for simultaneous detection and tracking of multiple objects. Demonstrates how neuromorphic computing can handle complex real-time vision tasks like MOT, which is critical for in-network edge intelligence and low-latency perception systems.
